queries.bars_fingerprint: SELECT count(*) AS n,md5(coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_set(jsonb_set(to_jsonb(f),'{available_at}',to_jsonb(extract(epoch from f.available_at))),'{acquired_at}',to_jsonb(extract(epoch from f.acquired_at))) ORDER BY id)::text,'')) AS fingerprint FROM daily_bars f
queries.events: SELECT protocol_id,event,payload FROM shadow_events ORDER BY id
queries.forecast_fingerprint: SELECT count(*) AS n,md5(coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_set(jsonb_set(to_jsonb(f),'{issued_at}',to_jsonb(extract(epoch from f.issued_at))),'{data_cutoff}',to_jsonb(extract(epoch from f.data_cutoff))) ORDER BY id)::text,'')) AS fingerprint FROM forecasts f
queries.job_events: SELECT job_id,event,detail FROM job_events ORDER BY id
queries.jobs: SELECT id,kind,payload,status,attempts,result,error FROM jobs ORDER BY id
queries.outcome_fingerprint: SELECT count(*) AS n,md5(coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_set(to_jsonb(f),'{resolved_at}',to_jsonb(extract(epoch from f.resolved_at))) ORDER BY id)::text,'')) AS fingerprint FROM forecast_outcomes f
queries.protocols: SELECT * FROM shadow_protocols ORDER BY id
queries.verdicts: SELECT protocol_id,status,report FROM shadow_verdicts ORDER BY protocol_id
